scoring_justification: Magnetic moments are computed from a full DFT relaxation pipeline; recomputing from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the checker sandbox. We compare the agent's reported values to paper-reported thresholds with permissive tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: thresholds for magnetic moments derived from paper text and the verification plan
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper states `calculated net atomic magnetic moment is ~0.05 μB/supercell` for Al+V_Si and shows no spin polarization for Al-only. The verification plan set Al+V_Si total in [0.03,0.07] μB, carbon >0.02 μB, Al-only total <0.001 μB. These thresholds are adopted here.
hidden_assets.generation_method: manually derived from paper claims and the taskability plan; tolerances chosen to accommodate different DFT implementations
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traceable to the paper's reported numerical result.

outputs.description: Magnetic moments per supercell and carbon atom contribution for the three doping configurations.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported values to paper-referenced thresholds. The agent must compute the moments from the relaxed DFT outputs; the values are not provided in the public instruction.

steps.description: Score the magnetic moments reported for the three supercell systems against paper-derived thresholds.
